main:1.text: Two years ago, Harry Osborn is staring at a vat containing the Venom symbiote. His father, Norman Osborn, reassures Harry the treatment will be good for him, before bonding Harry to the symbiote. Harry wakes up in the vat, bonded to the symbiote, before it is sealed and he is placed in stasis.

main:8.text: Peter Parker offered to investigate the area himself, instructing Miles Morales to take a break and focus on his college acceptance essay. Peter arrives at Williamsburg Bridge, but sees no sign of the Hunters anywhere. Peter contacts Miles and informs him, and Miles wonders if their intel was off. Peter witnesses a civilian littering as they drive on the bridge.

main:9.text: Peter Parker updates Miles Morales on what he learned at one of Kraven's bases. Kraven and his Hunters are hunting down Supervillains, revealing that he has killed Scorpion, and these are the people Flint Marko warned them about. Peter asks Miles to warn Black Cat about the impending threat, knowing she wouldn't listen to him, but maybe she would listen to someone she never met before.

main:10.text: Miles Morales receives a call from Ganke Lee that Quentin Beck, also known as Mysterio, built a new attraction at Coney Island after being released from prison. Suspecting he could be targeted by Kraven the Hunter, Miles decides to head there personally. He becomes embarrassed when Ganke reveals that Hailey Cooper is also at Coney Island, aware that Miles has a crush on her.

main:14.text: Miles Morales visits Rio Morales in her office, and Rio pleads for her son to move on from chasing Martin Li. She receives a call from her colleague, Angela, who works at the Harlem Cultural Center, that the security system locked her out and she cannot provide a tour to a highly-respected donor whose donation will prevent the Center from shutting down. Miles offers to suit up and go help Angela.

main:15.text: Peter Parker receives a call from Miles Morales, presumably to ask for his assistance with the stolen museum items. However, Peter asks to call Miles back later after receiving a call from Harry Osborn. Harry informs Peter that Curt Connors is still missing and to return to the Emily-May Foundation. main:17.text: With the serum in hand, Peter returns to the Emily-May Foundation building, dropping down through a roof hatch to meet Harry inside. Peter hands over the serum and begins analyzing its molecular structure. They discover the serum is unstable and realize they can use the building's particle accelerator to add electrons and stabilize it.

main:29.text: Shortly after the harrowing events at City Hall and Peter's transformation, a frantic call came through from Dr. Connors. Harry was at the lab, and from the sound of it, he was not himself and certainly not happy. Peter raced towards the objective, finding Oscorp trucks near a sewer entrance, a sure sign of Norman Osborn's involvement, with the distinct sounds of gunfire echoing from below ground.

main:30.text: Immediately following the grim revelations at Oscorp, with the city rapidly falling to the Symbiotes, Peter swung into action. He navigated the tendril-covered city, dodging attacks from Symbiotes on rooftops, to reach a Colexco store where civilians were trapped. His new Anti-Venom abilities made relatively quick work of the Symbiotes, and the grateful civilians were soon freed.
